visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an outdoor urban street setting during the day. A male character wearing an orange t-shirt, red pants, a red cap, and an orange crossbody bag leans against a red brick pillar. He is gesturing and talking to someone off-camera. In the background, there are trees, street signs, and a row of parked scooters under the bright natural daylight. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. (2) The scene shifts slightly as the man walks along the sidewalk, holding an orange iPhone box. He stops to show the box to the camera. The background shows a storefront with various signs and a row of arcade machines. (3) The setting moves indoors to a retail store with blue and white walls. The man talks to a shop owner behind a counter. The shop has glass display cases and various phone accessories on the walls. (4) A series of close-up shots show hands applying an orange film to a phone on a green cutting mat. A white squeegee tool is used to smooth the film over the camera lenses and the back of the device. (5) Back in the shop, the man is sitting on a red stool, holding the wrapped phone and looking at it with a satisfied expression. He then walks toward the glass door. (6) The final scene is outdoors in front of a restaurant with a sign that says '橘色'. The man stands in the narrow alleyway, talks to the camera, and then turns around and runs away into the distance, with buildings and umbrellas visible in the background.

(2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX triggers the entry of an upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop BGM. The man speaks quickly in a friendly, animated tone about waiting for a long time. (3) A series of rapid digital clicks and UI-style SFX are heard as he interacts with his phone. (4) Inside the shop, the acoustic environment becomes more reverberant. The man talks to another male with lower pitch, requesting a screen protector. (5) A rhythmic scraping and rustling sound of plastic and squeegee tools dominates the mix for several seconds, representing the wrapping process. (6) A pre-recorded laughter track SFX plays as the man teases his friend's old phone. (7) The music continues to build as he expresses extreme satisfaction with high-pitched exclamations. (8) The video ends with rapid percussive thuds representing footsteps on pavement, ending with a sharp synthesized 'whoosh' transition SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interaction -> Service Process -> Satire -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic short video is designed to showcase a fictional 'iPhone 17 Pro Max' in a vibrant orange color and promote the screen wrapping and protection services of the '手機達人' shop. It uses a relatable skit about showing off new tech and teasing friends with older devices to engage the audience, ultimately concluding with a humorous escape from an expensive restaurant bill.
